name: Sinnia's mask
description: A scale-crusted deep-gold mask with snake-like sticks and wooden fangs that holds all of Saryth's power and fuses to Sinnia's skin.

timeline.summary: At an abandoned tent of a missing family, Sinnia finds a scale-crusted golden mask and tries it on over Leinore's objections.
timeline.quote: Sinnia took off her fox mask and tried on the new one, causing Leinore to flinch.

timeline.summary: Sinnia whispers for help and Leinore tears the fused mask off her face as the Coiled One bends to swallow them.
timeline.quote: Without thinking she started to pull as hard as she could.

relations.note: All of Saryth's power is in the mask.
relations.quote: All of Saryth's power is in that mask.
